  python3 /opt/ctk/agent.py --control-server https://server1.com --control-server-H "Auth: token1" \

help.text:
usage: python3 /opt/ctk/agent.py [-h] COMMAND ...

Snyk Agent Scan: Security scanner for Model Context Protocol servers, agents, skills and tools

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

Commands:
  Available commands (default: scan)

  COMMAND
    scan      Scan one or more MCP config files [default]
    inspect   Print descriptions of tools, prompts, and resources without
              verification
    help      Show detailed help information
    evo       Push scan results to Snyk Evo
    guard     Install, uninstall, or check status of Agent Guard hooks

Examples:
  python3 /opt/ctk/agent.py                      # Scan all known MCP configs
  python3 /opt/ctk/agent.py ~/custom/config.json # Scan a specific config file
  python3 /opt/ctk/agent.py inspect              # Just inspect tools without verification
  python3 /opt/ctk/agent.py --no-skills          # Scan only mcp servers, skip skills.
  python3 /opt/ctk/agent.py --verbose            # Enable detailed logging output
  python3 /opt/ctk/agent.py --print-errors       # Show error details and tracebacks
  python3 /opt/ctk/agent.py --json               # Output results in JSON format
  python3 /opt/ctk/agent.py --ci                 # With --ci, exit with a non-zero code when there are analysis findings or runtime failures

  # Multiple control servers with individual options:
  python3 /opt/ctk/agent.py --control-server https://server1.com --control-server-H "Auth: token1" \
    --control-identifier user@example.com \
    --control-server https://server2.com --control-server-H "Auth: token2" \
    --control-identifier serial-123

--analysis-url.help: URL endpoint for the verification server

--background.help: Periodically run the scan in the background

--base-url.help: Base URL for the verification server

--checks-per-server.help: Number of times to check each server (default: 1)

--ci.help: Exit with a non-zero code when there are analysis findings or runtime failures. Requires --dangerously-run-mcp-servers.

--client-name.help: Name of the client issuing the scan

--control-identifier.help: Required per --control-server block. Non-anonymous identifier for that control server (for example: email, hostname, serial number).

--dangerously-run-mcp-servers.help: Skip the interactive consent prompt and start every stdio MCP server listed in the scanned configs.

--file.help: Override the config file path (default: client-specific well-known path)

--full-toxic-flows.help: Show all tools that could take part in toxic flow. By default only the top 3 are shown.

--help.help: show this help message and exit

--ignore-issues-codes.help: Comma-separated list of issue codes to ignore (e.g. W001,W015)

--json.help: Output results in JSON format instead of rich text

--local-only.help: Only update local whitelist, don't contribute to global whitelist

--managed.help: Uninstall hooks from the managed (admin/MDM) config path instead of the user-level path

--mcp-oauth-tokens-path.help: Path of the file where the MCP OAuth tokens are stored.

--no-bootstrap.help: Disable the startup bootstrap call to the control server.

--scan-all-users.help: Scan all users on the machine.

--scan-interval.help: Scan interval in seconds (default: 1800 seconds = 30 minutes)

--server-timeout.help: Seconds to wait before timing out server connections (default: 10)

--skills.help: Scan skills beyond mcp servers (default: enabled). Use --no-skills to disable.

--storage-file.help: Path to store scan results and scanner state

--suppress-mcpserver-io.help: Suppress stderr from stdio MCP servers (stdout carries the JSON-RPC protocol and is never shown). Default: False for interactive runs (stderr is streamed with a [server-name] prefix), True otherwise.

--tenant-id.help: Snyk tenant ID (required when minting a push key; not needed if PUSH_KEY is set)

--verification-H.help: Additional headers for the verification server

evo.help: Push scan results to Snyk Evo

file.help: File to install the MCP server in

files.help: Path(s) to MCP config file(s). If not provided, well-known paths will be checked

guard.help: Install, uninstall, or check status of Agent Guard hooks

hash.help: Hash of the entity to whitelist

inspect.help: Print descriptions of tools, prompts, and resources without verification

install.help: Install Agent Guard hooks for a client

install-mcp-server.help: Install itself as a MCP server for automatic scanning (experimental)

name.help: Name of the entity to whitelist

scan.help: Scan one or more MCP config files [default]

type.help: Type of entity to whitelist (default: tool)

uninstall.help: Remove Agent Guard hooks for a client

whitelist.help: Manage the whitelist of approved entities
